pattern.rule: In a Conflicting-Viewpoints item whose stem gives a new (hypothetical or stated) finding and asks which viewpoint/scientist/hypothesis it strengthens, supports, weakens or is consistent with, and whose options each read '<scientist/hypothesis>, because <reason>', pick the option whose because-clause restates the finding's own content in the same direction (same quantity, same direction of change).
pattern.why: Both graders named the same CV because-clause rule. Applied to all 80 items from the cold packet by a fresh agent (scratchpad/act-science-regrade/_r8/b1/picks.json) before the key was opened; decides = items where the rule picked exactly one option and it is the key.
